root_cause: The preflight had two fail-closed size guards, but the fixed 96-source count became stale before the still-valid 256 KB serialized byte budget was reached. Current canonical state requires 97 small sources, so unrelated material PRs failed despite remaining inside the byte budget.
prevention: Keep both guards, make source fanout an explicit contract budget of 128, and retain the serialized 256 KB maxBytes limit as the primary context-size authority. Explicit test overrides remain supported and fail closed.
